message.content:
I don’t know the exact numbers—each company keeps that to themselves. But from what I’ve seen, some have just a handful, while others might have dozens flying at once, depending on the job.

The big thing for us isn’t how many drones they have, but how many *corridors* or *sites* they use. If a closure blocks a key route, that can mess with a lot of flights, no matter how many drones are out there. But again, we don’t track that per company—just the airspace itself.
